list: The official 55 trophies, as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles on 18 November 2026 and cross-checked by GTABase and PowerPyx. Names, descriptions and grades are PlayStation's own words; every guide below is written in our own words for this ledger, with its source named beside it. Where no guide had pinned a trigger down by launch day, the guide says so instead of guessing.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: Earn the other 54 trophies and this one unlocks by itself. PowerPyx rates the whole run about 200 hours at difficulty 4 out of 10, with A Long Road (100% completion) the longest grind. There are no online trophies, no difficulty trophies and no mission medals, so the platinum is long rather than hard.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Play the opening mission Gone Fishing in Chapter 1; the trophy pops when the mission ends. It is a story trophy, so it cannot be missed — just keep playing the story. PowerPyx lists it as an automatic story unlock.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Finish every main mission of Chapter 1. The trophy unlocks when the chapter closes. Before the chapter ends, do Lucia's balcony meditation at Jason's house (see Positive Mental Attitude) — it is the one thing in Chapter 1 that may not come back.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Finish every main mission of Chapter 2. The trophy unlocks when the chapter closes. Chapter 2 is also when Jason and Lucia become playable together, which opens up most of the free-roam trophies, so use the chapter to start scanning vehicles and trying activities.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Finish every main mission of Chapter 3. The trophy unlocks when the chapter closes. The robbery trophies open up around Chapters 3 and 4, so from here on, keep an eye out for bank vaults, armored trucks and gang operations while you play.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Finish every main mission of Chapter 4. The trophy unlocks when the chapter closes. Before the finale, make a manual save: there is no mission replay and no New Game Plus, so a save from before the final mission is your only way back.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Finish the final mission and watch the credits roll. This is one of only two gold trophies, and it opens the 100% completion checklist (Progress, then Stats, then 100% Completion), which stays hidden until the story is done. Keep a manual save from just before the finale.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Finish the story mission Breakfast Run. It is a story trophy that unlocks when the mission ends, so it cannot be missed. PowerPyx lists it among the automatic story unlocks.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Finish the story mission The Cartel Heist. It is a story trophy that unlocks when the mission ends, so it cannot be missed. Heist-style missions are also good practice for the robbery trophies that follow.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Finish the story mission Child's Play. It is a story trophy that unlocks when the mission ends, so it cannot be missed. PowerPyx lists it among the automatic story unlocks.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Finish the story mission Headliners. It is a story trophy that unlocks when the mission ends, so it cannot be missed. PowerPyx lists it among the automatic story unlocks.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Finish the story mission VCIA Takedown at Vice City International Airport. It is a story trophy that unlocks when the mission ends. The airport is also where the free-roam trophy Catch Me If You Can happens, so you will know the layout by the time you come back for it.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Finish the story mission Operation Savage Glory. It is a story trophy that unlocks when the mission ends, so it cannot be missed. PowerPyx lists it among the automatic story unlocks.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Finish the story, then clear the 35-item 100% checklist under Progress, then Stats, then 100% Completion. PowerPyx says the checklist is lenient — closer to 60% of everything in the game — and nothing on it is missable, since every item can be done in free roam after the credits. The strictest items are all 39 gang operations, all 33 underwater discoveries, all shooting ranges and all drone races; most other items only need part of the set, such as 15 of 18 card sets or 70 of 80 challenges.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Pull off 250 stunts across Leonida — stunt jumps, going under bridges, knife flights and base jumps. The 100% checklist counts 300 of 397 stunts, so working toward A Long Road covers most of this trophy on the way. Track progress under Progress, then Stats, and chase stunts in free roam after the story, when nothing can interrupt you.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once — one round of everything the map offers, from bowling and fishing to the shooting range and drone races. You do not need to win or score well; just start each activity once. Do this early, in Chapter 2, when both characters are playable and the map opens up.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. There are no mission gold medals in this game — the shooting range is the only place gold medals exist, alongside 13 race challenges, per PowerPyx. Take your time and learn each range's weapon and target pattern; the ranges are repeatable, so a bad run costs nothing.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations. Drone races are also a 100% checklist item, so every win counts twice. Learn each course's line before racing for the win, and retry as often as you like — races are repeatable and nothing here is missable.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races — each race only counts once, so you need 20 distinct events, not 20 wins of the same one. Mix car, bike, boat and drone races across the map. Races are repeatable and nothing here is missable, so work through them in free roam after the story.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Fishing with Cal also counts toward the 100 optional tasks on the 100% checklist, so take every fishing challenge he offers. There is no confirmed missable window for Cal's challenges, and PowerPyx says nothing on the 100% checklist is missable.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Finish one arcade game to the end — any arcade cabinet, any game. You do not need a high score, just a completed run. Arcades are found around Vice City; try one early so the trophy is banked and out of the way.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Play through Andy's stranger mission strand to its final mission and finish it. Stranger strands appear as side missions across Leonida; PowerPyx notes there are far more optional missions than the 100 the checklist asks for, so a strand you skip does not lock you out. Andy's strand is one of the six stranger finals this ledger tracks.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Play through Kenton's stranger mission strand to its final mission and finish it. Kenton's strand involves treasure diving around Key Lento, and his sets feed the 100% checklist too (5 of 7 Kenton sets). Do the strand as it appears; nothing in it is missable.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Play through Billy's stranger mission strand to its final mission and finish it. Stranger strands unlock as you explore Leonida, so keep checking the map for new side-mission icons between story chapters. Nothing in Billy's strand is missable.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 full stranger mission strands across Leonida. The six named stranger finals (Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone and Bret) already give you six of the eight; find two more strands while exploring. PowerPyx says there are far more optional missions than needed, and the time-limited ones (hourglass icon) do not affect trophies, so do not panic if one expires.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Play through Randy's stranger mission strand to its final mission and finish it. Randy's deliveries also count toward the 100 optional tasks on the 100% checklist, per PowerPyx, so his strand pulls double duty. Nothing in it is missable.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Play through Tyrone's stranger mission strand to its final mission and finish it. Tyrone's labs also count toward the 100 optional tasks on the 100% checklist, per PowerPyx. Nothing in his strand is missable.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 spots across 10 locations. The first one is the only possibly missable trophy in the game: in Chapter 1, the morning after the mission Down to Earth, talk to Lucia in the kitchen at Jason's house — she says she is going to meditate, follows her to the balcony and choose Accept. That session is gone after Chapter 1, and PowerPyx and GTABase both say it is unconfirmed whether the trophy needs it, so do it to be safe. Meditating at a spot with Jason and Lucia together counts twice, and the last spot (Mount Kalaga) only appears after the other spots are done. The 100% checklist only needs 15 of 18, so this trophy is stricter than 100%.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt the unique animal Bret asks for and bring it back to him. Bret's hunting quests are also a 100% checklist item — every one of them is required — so do them as they appear rather than leaving them for later. Studying animals with binoculars (100 of 255 for the checklist) is separate from hunting, so scan animals whenever you see them.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete any 3 of the 18 collectible card sets. There are 480 cards in total across the sets, and the 100% checklist needs 15 complete sets, so this silver is an early milestone on the way to A Long Road. Track sets under Progress, then Collections, then Collectible Cards, and grab cards whenever you pass them.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Scan 100 locations with the WAiNK phone app — landmarks, sculptures and curiosities. Walk on foot near a scannable spot and the game shows a prompt; hold the scan buttons when it appears. Track them under Progress, then Collections, then WAiNK Locations. This is also a 100% checklist item, and scanning vehicles (200 of 277 base models) is a separate checklist line, so scan cars as they pass too.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete any 50 of the 80 challenges — 8 categories with 10 challenges each, per PowerPyx. The 100% checklist needs 70 of 80, so this bronze arrives naturally while you chase A Long Road. Pick the easy categories first and leave the hardest challenges for last.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, build a 4-star wanted level, then lose the cops and escape. Do it in open country where you can break line of sight — the wanted level drops once no officer can see either of you. It is repeatable, so if the heat catches you, just try again.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner, rob 3 shops in a row without losing your wanted level — the trick is the opposite of Hot Together: keep the heat, do not shake it. Pick three shops close together, move fast between them, and do not let the wanted level drop to zero between robberies. If it drops, start the chain again.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles — drive or ride anything new and it counts. Leonida holds around 557 vehicles in total, per PowerPyx, so 100 comes quickly if you keep switching rides instead of sticking to one car. The 100% checklist separately asks you to WAiNK-scan 200 of 277 base models, so scan new cars as you discover them.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Down 5 enemies during one use of Combat Focus. Set it up where enemies bunch together — a gang operation or a robbery shootout — and trigger Combat Focus only once you have five targets in view. If you run out of targets, retry the fight; nothing here is missable.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Leave Vice City International Airport in a plane without a scheduled flight — take off from VCIA in an aircraft that is not part of a mission. The airport opens up during the story (see Hi-Jacked), so this is a free-roam trophy: grab a plane on the tarmac and get airborne.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: No confirmed trigger yet at launch: PowerPyx lists this trophy's exact unlock as not yet known, and the description only hints at the Rhino tank. The safe reading is that it involves the Rhino — getting in one, or surviving one — so try the tank when you find one in free roam and check Progress after. This ledger will not invent a step the guides have not confirmed.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected — get in, take the goods and get out before any alarm or witness spots you. Jewelry stores are also Smash 'N' Grab targets for the 100% checklist (34 of 35), so a clean run counts toward both. Go at night, move quietly, and leave before the alarm spreads.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape after each one. Bank vaults open up in Chapters 3 and 4, per the launch guides, so do not hunt for them early. Plan the escape route before you go in, and lose the wanted level before starting the next vault.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Armored trucks drive set routes around Leonida — stop one, crack it open, take the cash and lose the wanted level. One clean robbery is enough; if the cops catch you, try another truck.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all 52 areas of Leonida. Drive, fly and sail the whole map — the game tracks each area the first time you enter it. The fastest way is a slow flyover or a road trip after the story, when no mission can pull you away. Check the map for areas you have never entered.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. Gang operations are also a 100% checklist item — all 39 of them, looting the key valuables at each — so clearing operations for A Long Road covers this trophy on the way. Track them under Progress, and finish each gang's operations before moving on.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: No confirmed trigger yet at launch: PowerPyx lists this trophy as not yet known, beyond what the description says — a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. The honest move is to visit Ocean Beach, find a bar with a view, and order a cocktail there; if it does not pop, the trigger is a specific spot the guides have not pinned down yet. Do not trust any rumoured location that cites no source.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: No confirmed trigger yet at launch: PowerPyx lists this trophy as not yet known, beyond what the description says — smashing out of a vehicle showroom. The description points to driving a car through a showroom window, in the style of the classic GTA moment, but no guide has confirmed the exact showroom or vehicle yet. Try a showroom in free roam and check Progress after.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Bowl at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley and finish a game — follow through on your throws. Bowling is one of the 9 activity types for Master of None, so this trophy and that one overlap. A finished game is enough; you do not need a high score.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: No confirmed trigger yet at launch: the launch guides say this trophy points to a story moment with Jason and Lucia — a partnership moment with mass appeal — but none has pinned down the exact scene. Play through the story and it should unlock on its own; do not chase a rumoured trigger that cites no source.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: No confirmed trigger yet at launch: the launch guides say this trophy points to a story choice — choices made, for better or worse — but none has pinned down which choice or mission. GTABase advises keeping separate manual saves before big story choices as cheap insurance. Play the story, make the choices, and the trophy should follow.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: No confirmed trigger yet at launch: PowerPyx lists this trophy as not yet known, beyond what the description says — second time's the charm. The wording suggests succeeding at something on a second attempt, likely in a story mission, but no guide has confirmed the exact moment. Play the story and retry anything you fail; do not trust a rumoured trigger that cites no source.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: No confirmed trigger yet at launch: PowerPyx lists this trophy as not yet known, beyond what the description says — something strange happens. The wording points to an odd story or world event, but no guide has confirmed where or when. Keep playing and explore; this ledger will not invent a location the guides have not confirmed.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: No confirmed trigger yet at launch: PowerPyx lists this trophy as not yet known, beyond what the description says — knocking someone over with a melee drive-by. The wording suggests hitting a pedestrian with a melee attack from a moving vehicle, possibly near the bowling alley, but no guide has confirmed the exact method. Try it in free roam and check Progress after.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 by laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills come from robberies — bank vaults, armored trucks and gang operations — so this trophy grows as you work the robbery trophies. Fence the bills through your contacts whenever you have them; the total is cumulative across the whole playthrough.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 in total across all shops — clothes, weapons, food, anything with a price tag. The total is cumulative, so it builds up naturally if you buy gear as you play; if you are short near the end, buy expensive items such as vehicles or high-end clothing to close the gap. Track your spending in the stats menu.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Buy all 8 garage properties across Leonida. Garages cost money, so this trophy pairs with the money trophies: rob, fence and save, then buy garages as you can afford them. Each garage also stores vehicles, which helps with Whip It Good and the vehicle scanning checklist.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Find vehicles around Leonida, then register each one in the app — the count is cumulative, so any 10 vehicles will do. Do it alongside Whip It Good (discover 100 vehicles), since every vehicle you discover is a candidate to register.
